description: Rug check and token verdict for any Base token: one answer (ok, caution, avoid or known issuer) with a 0-100 risk score and plain reasons, before you buy, accept or list it. Checks the owner powers in the contract (mint, pause, blacklist, fees, proxy), who holds the supply, whether it can be sold and its real buy/sell tax (simulated), and whether the token or its owner is on the OFAC sanctions list or a scam blacklist. Not charged for invalid input. Paid via x402; see list_prices.
name: token_report
